item.title: Uber shuts operations in Nigeria and Uganda with immediate effect
item.description:
📝 Uber shuts operations in Nigeria and Uganda with immediate effect3 hours agoShareSaveAdd as preferred on GoogleMakuochi OkaforBBC Africa, LagosGetty ImagesOn the African continent, Uber now only operates in Egypt, Ghana, Kenya and South AfricaUber has announced it is closing its operations in Nigeria - Africa's most populous country - and the East African nation of Uganda with immediate effectThe global ride-hailing giant said it had come to the "difficult decision" after a thorough review of its business. Uber to cut over 3,000 jobs in major global restructuringOver the last year, Uber has also pulled out of Ivory Coast and Tanzania. Uber pledged to support employees and drivers affected by the decision and said its help centre would remain open for those in Nigeria and Uganda until 23 September to deal with outstanding issues.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c86xpv8l9y9o

item.title: Earth's organisms developed via evolution. What if the cosmos did, too?
item.description:
📝 But can that really be called more significant than gravity. Evolutionary cosmologists instead argue that universes, like living organisms, grow and reproduce, spinning off new universes with small variations from their progenitors. And why would that not apply to the universe itself.
